notes: Circus Solitaire now follows the approved illustrated design: rich burgundy felt, velvet curtains, warm marquee lights, an ornate gold title, gold-framed controls, and the full circus deck artwork on every card. The table fills the phone screen, with larger cards and clearer overlapping stacks. Drag-and-drop, hints, Undo, foundation rewards, difficulty settings and shared live play are retained. This update changes solitaire presentation only; other games, rules, rooms, saves and profiles remain intact.
